subject: Continuous live fusion of new data with explicit research re-entry

basis.repo_observation: No verified real-repo execution receipt was established in this turn; candidate remains unpromoted.

live_external_research.title: Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering
live_external_research.finding: Production-scale incremental maintenance benefits from cost-based strategy selection rather than assuming one refresh strategy is always best.
live_external_research.clay_implication: Strengthens RoutePlan as an adaptive cost/recall/risk decision. Do not dogmatically force TARGETED_DELTA when dense/global refresh is cheaper or safer.

live_external_research.title: Approximate Query Processing under Updates
live_external_research.finding: Bounded approximation can reduce incremental update cost for some aggregation workloads.
live_external_research.clay_implication: Permit approximation only in non-authoritative priority/telemetry shadows. Canonical evidence, provenance, causal identity, effect authority and research-state mutation remain exact/fail-closed.

live_external_research.title: Benchmarking the Full Pipeline of Materialized-View-Based Query Rewriting
live_external_research.finding: End-to-end behavior depends on interactions among candidate enumeration, selection and rewriting; isolated stage wins can regress the full pipeline.
live_external_research.clay_implication: Benchmark the full live-fusion chain source->normalize->delta->fuse->route->receiver reconstruct/use->research reentry, with stage ablations and end-to-end outcome/resource metrics.

live_external_research.title: The Role of Semirings in Incremental View Maintenance
live_external_research.finding: Incremental-maintenance complexity depends on the algebra used, including provenance-related semirings.
live_external_research.clay_implication: Research a provenance-preserving delta algebra for UnifiedDB/ClayGraph projections, but do not reopen BASE ClayCode semantics unless an executable counterexample requires it.

research_delta.name: CONTINUOUS_LIVE_FUSION_REENTRY_V1
research_delta.summary: Treat every admitted new internal or external observation as a provenance-bound delta that is fused against current research state, routed by current dependency topology, and required to produce explicit re-entry into hypotheses, counterhypotheses, experiments, tests, architecture/work, negative results or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE.
research_delta.all_new_data_semantics: All new data means all newly observed data from currently authorized/connected source adapters and runtime/repository evidence streams within declared freshness/SLO scope. It does not mean exhaustive crawling of the entire internet or unverifiable universal completeness.

dual_lane.EXACT_RESEARCH_STATE: Canonical evidence/provenance/causal/effect/research mutation lane. No approximate truth. Missing/stale evidence remains UNKNOWN or DEGRADED.
dual_lane.APPROXIMATE_PRIORITY_SHADOW: Optional bounded sketches/approximation for prioritization, anomaly ranking, route-cost estimation and candidate triage only. Cannot mint truth, causal credit, authority or canonical state.

promotion_guard: This delta refines research/test obligations only. It does not promote CLAY_LIVE_FUSION_MESH_V2_CANDIDATE and grants no BASE ClayCode acceptance credit.

branches.clayresearch: Every material new datum must terminate in an explicit research re-entry effect or evidence-backed NO_CHANGE, not a stranded report.
branches.frank: Frank-related live evidence may alter research priorities and Harness proposals only through Research Entity authority; Frank self-Harness authority remains proposal-only.
branches.gwt: Measure delta delivered/reconstructed/used/research-effect separately; mere exposure is not causal uptake.
branches.emergenz: Test whether stronger fusion causes overcoupling, synchrony collapse, false interrupts or self-reinforcing evidence loops; connectivity remains non-evidence.
branches.claycode: Represent exact research-state and shadow-priority lanes with typed authority separation using current semantics first; reopen semantics only for executable counterexamples.
branches.hyperposition: Keep competing route plans and unresolved interpretations live until evidence selects; approximate shadow may rank but not collapse canonical alternatives.
branches.claygraph: Use current derived dependency topology for targeted propagation, while exposing stale/missing-edge uncertainty and forcing anti-entropy repair.
branches.unifieddb: Persist source observation, canonical delta, fusion/reentry receipts and exact-vs-shadow lane identity transactionally with coherent semantic epochs.
branches.harness: Extend real replay to the full source-to-research-reentry pipeline and execute fault/ablation matrix before architectural promotion.

global_controls: Frank remains separate research subject and never mutates Clay
